title: Blood Tech
description: Use your blood(or others) to generate a variety of effects
body:
Use your blood(and others) to power a multitude of effects

 

Use a syringe to obtain blood from yourself or mobs that you can then use tor directly power the effect generator or break down further using the centrifuge

 

The centrifuge provides a way of obtaining many of the items added by this mod as well as an alternative way to acquire iron

 

The effect generator provides a more customable way to acquire effects than the beacon, even allowing you to intentionally acquire negative effects, via its many charms, at the cost of having to continually power it using blood.
